featured_reviews.review_text:
Khilafat movement, force that arose in India in the early 20th century as a result of Muslim fears for the integrityof Islam. These fears were aroused by Italian (1911) and Balkan (1912–13) attacks on Turkey—whose sultan, as caliph, was the religious head of the worldwide Muslim community—and by Turkish defeats in World War I. They were intensified by the Treaty of Sèvres (August 1920), which not only detached all non-Turkish regions from the empire but also gave parts of the Turkish homeland to Greece and other non-Muslim powers.
A campaign in defense of the caliph was launched, led in India by the brothers Shaukat and Muḥammad ʿAlī and by Abul Kalam Azad. The leaders joined forces with Mahatma Gandhi’s noncooperation movementfor Indian freedom, promising nonviolence in return for his support of the Khilafat movement. In 1920 the latter movement was marred by the ḥijrat, or exodus, from India to Afghanistan of about 18,000 Muslim peasants, who felt that India was an apostate land. It was also tarnished by the Muslim Moplah rebellion in south India (Malabar) in 1921, the excesses of which deeply stirred Hindu India. Gandhi’s suspension of his movement and his arrest in March 1922 weakened the Khilafat movement still further. It was further undermined when Mustafa KemalAtatürk drove the Greeks from western Asia Minor in 1922 and deposed the Turkish sultan in the same year; it finally collapsed when he abolished the caliphate altogether in 1924.

Very renowned and very prestigious college of India during British period too.Elphinstone College is an historic institution in Mumbai, India, established in 1856 in honor of Mountstuart Elphinstone. It is known for its Gothic-inspired architecture and its role in shaping the city's academic and cultural landscape. The college offers a variety of undergraduate and postgraduate programs and is affiliated with the University of Mumbai.
History: Founded in 1856, it was named after the departing Governor of Bombay, Mountstuart Elphinstone. The college was formally established after 1835 when classes began in 1836. It became an independent institution in 1956 and was affiliated with the University of Mumbai in 1860.
Location: Elphinstone College is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, at 156, Mahatma Gandhi Road, Mantralaya.
Architecture: The college is recognized for its stunning, Gothic-inspired architecture.
Academics: It offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, including B.Sc., MA, and BA. It is known for its academic rigor and commitment to developing critical thinking skills and social responsibility.
Affiliation: The college is affiliated with the University of Mumbai.

This is a formal warning regarding Ahmad Hamdan Jukhaidim, a Syrian national currently pursuing a bachelor's degree at KITA University in India. He has committed fraud by deceiving students under the pretense of helping them apply to Indian universities. He impersonated official university email accounts — including those of the University of Mumbai, University of Delhi, and University of Calcutta — and created fake email addresses to send false admission letters to students. He also collected large sums of money from them in the process.

We kindly urge the Indian government and the mentioned universities to investigate this matter seriously and take appropriate legal action. He currently resides in India and is enrolled at KITA University.

The university operates primarily from two campuses: the Fort Campus, known for its historic Rajabai Clock Tower, and the expansive Kalina Campus, which spans 243 acres and provides a serene environment conducive to learning and research.  ￼

Students have access to comprehensive facilities, including separate hostels for boys and girls, well-furnished rooms, spacious classrooms, and full-time internet connectivity.  The Jawaharlal Nehru Library serves as a central resource, housing an extensive collection of academic materials.  ￼ ￼

The university has produced notable alumni who have significantly contributed to various fields. However, some students have expressed concerns regarding placement opportunities, citing limited campus recruitment and lower salary packages.  Despite these challenges, the University of Mumbai remains a prominent educational institution, blending historical significance with academic diversity. ￼

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m really glad I chose this college for my BCA degree. It’s honestly one of the best colleges for BCA because of the way they focus on both academics and student comfort. The teachers here are extremely attentive towards every student, making sure no one feels left out.

One of the things I appreciate the most is how stress-free exams feel. Since the faculty conducts regular tests on different topics, we get to practice and understand everything in advance. By the time exams arrive, there’s no pressure at all.

The teachers aren’t just teachers – they feel more like mentors and friends. Their way of teaching keeps the lectures engaging, so it never feels boring. This makes learning much easier and helps us really understand the concepts instead of just memorizing.

Overall, I’d highly recommend this college for anyone who wants to pursue BCA. It’s a perfect mix of supportive teachers, a friendly atmosphere, and quality education.
